dedupe_keys.name: satellite data before and after covid 19

description: The Universitas Brawijaya research team publishes a dataset containing satellite observations for Jakarta before and during the 2020 COVID-19 disruption. The Mendeley Data deposit supports the article comparison of atmospheric nitrogen dioxide, night-time lights and land-surface temperature from Sentinel-5P, VIIRS and Landsat 8, processed using Google Earth Engine. Its public version-1 landing page states CC-BY-4.0, making access free; file formats and exact sampling intervals were not established from the inspected metadata. These observations can help test urban activity and environmental-response scenarios and complement data-esa-worldcover for spatial context. The signals are proxies for traffic, energy use and human activity, not direct measurements of those services. Seasonal weather, cloud filtering and different sensor resolutions limit causal interpretation. A before-and-during comparison alone cannot attribute all changes to mobility restrictions.
